_comment: Methods dispatched by src/Cedar/Admin.c that are absent from the official vpnrpc.ts stubs. Field names verified against a live 5.x server (build 5187). Parallel arrays: element i of each array forms one record.

GetPortsUDP.name: GetPortsUDP
GetPortsUDP.doc: Get the list of UDP ports the server listens on for UDP-based protocols (OpenVPN, WireGuard, etc.).

SetPortsUDP.name: SetPortsUDP
SetPortsUDP.doc: Set the list of UDP ports the server listens on. Replaces the entire list. Requires server administrator privileges.

GetProtoOptions.name: GetProtoOptions
GetProtoOptions.doc: Get per-protocol options (e.g. OpenVPN, WireGuard, SSTP). Specify Protocol_str. Options are returned as parallel arrays Name_str / Type_u32 (1=string, 2=bool, 3=uint32) / Value_bin (base64 raw value; strings are NUL-terminated, uint32 little-endian).

SetProtoOptions.name: SetProtoOptions
SetProtoOptions.doc: Set per-protocol options. Same encoding as GetProtoOptions. Requires server administrator privileges.

GetServerCipherList.name: GetServerCipherList
GetServerCipherList.doc: Get the ';'-separated list of TLS cipher suites supported by the server's TLS library.

AddWgk.name: AddWgk
AddWgk.doc: Register WireGuard client public keys, each mapped to a Virtual Hub and user. Parallel arrays Key_str / Hub_str / User_str.

DeleteWgk.name: DeleteWgk
DeleteWgk.doc: Delete WireGuard client public keys (specify Key_str entries).

EnumWgk.name: EnumWgk
EnumWgk.doc: List registered WireGuard client public keys with their Virtual Hub and user mapping.

AddLicenseKey.name: AddLicenseKey
AddLicenseKey.doc: Add a license key (commercial PacketiX editions only; returns 'Unsupported' on open-source editions). Key in StrValue_str.

DelLicenseKey.name: DelLicenseKey
DelLicenseKey.doc: Delete a license key by id in IntValue_u32 (commercial editions only).

EnumLicenseKey.name: EnumLicenseKey
EnumLicenseKey.doc: List registered license keys (commercial editions only).

EnumEthVLan.name: EnumEthVLan
EnumEthVLan.doc: List Windows network adapters and whether VLAN tag pass-through is enabled (Windows servers only).

SetEnableEthVLan.name: SetEnableEthVLan
SetEnableEthVLan.doc: Enable/disable VLAN tag pass-through on a Windows network adapter: StrValue_str = adapter GUID/name, IntValue_u32 = 1 enable / 0 disable (Windows servers only).

Debug.name: Debug
Debug.doc: Internal debug command. IntValue_u32 = debug command id, StrValue_str = argument. For diagnostics only.

fields.name: Protocol_str
fields.doc: Protocol name, e.g. OpenVPN, WireGuard, SSTP
